body:
Closes #336

The gateway inherited nginx's full request-line access log, exposing search text and OIDC code/state in general logs. It now explicitly records only time, HTTP status, response size and duration at server scope. Matter names, arbitrary paths, queries, headers and bodies are excluded. Request-context nginx error diagnostics are suppressed at HTTP scope because nginx embeds request content in those messages; startup/process diagnostics remain available, failed/rejected requests still have content-free status records, and application security audit is unchanged. This trades request-specific nginx error detail for content-free failure accounting; no live service or setting was changed.

Based on current main `347f10807d9cc584c3c2af9a0bec9a19a0bf6d8e`. #341 (`codex/340-historical-checksum`) merged on Oct 19, so its historical checksum disposition now comes from main and this PR is no longer stacked. This PR changes seven files: the gateway template (`deploy/gateway/default.conf.template`), the gateway image (`deploy/gateway/Dockerfile`, envsubst filter), a gateway logging paragraph in `docs/SECURITY_MODEL.md`, a pinned copy of the pinned image's stock `nginx.conf` with a README under `tests/fixtures/gateway/`, `tests/test_gateway_nginx.py` (configuration pin, logging drift mutations and the content-free logging regression) and `tests/test_checker_fail_closed_contract.py`. No merge is authorized.

Fix level: repository-owned nginx configuration prevents inherited base-image access logging. A server-level override is necessary: another HTTP-level access_log adds to the stock logger instead of replacing it. Tests retain both identity-header families and the existing throttle.

Kickoff: https://example.com/synthetic/project/issues/336#issuecomment-6270633270: posted before the implementation commit, matching scope and acceptance. Reviewer must verify author, timing and scope.

Local validation below was recorded on earlier head `1f7e1ffb4977eb7b15cd4f7b691b4543efbf2821`. The current head is `922a8ed`; its CI evidence is listed at the end.

- `PYTHONPATH=src $PYTHON -m pytest -q tests/test_gateway_nginx.py -k content_free`: 1 passed. Pins exact content-free fields and logging destinations.
- Same `GatewayHeaderContract` executed through an external disposable native nginx 1.30.5 loopback harness: passed. The harness substitutes only native process control, test ports and scratch TLS paths for Docker commands and supplies the stock full-request HTTP log. Success, 400 malformed Host, 414 oversized target, 503 real rate-limit rejection and 502 unavailable upstream retain safe records. Search, code/state, nested redirect, matter path, cookie, Authorization, Referer, User-Agent and body markers appear in neither stdout nor stderr. Both identity-header families are still stripped on both locations. The observer's own access logging is disabled to isolate the actual gateway.
- The identical behavioral regression against unchanged main `1d524a3a44488c8de75b6afcd823b9d0df4a2122` fails on leaked synthetic content. The static check also fails on the missing format/override.
- `make check-fast PYTHON=$PYTHON GITLEAKS=$GITLEAKS`: compile, all 12 Compose variants and read-only preflight passed, then the all-refs publication scan stopped on unrelated historical media-fixture residue. That remote-branch commit is not an ancestor of this candidate. No exception was added or changed. This is not a complete local gate pass.
- `make secret-check GITLEAKS=$GITLEAKS`: passed with #341's historical checksum disposition, which is now on main. Original main configuration failed on exactly #340's historical checksum fingerprint. Working-tree publication scan and `git diff --check` passed. The installed unchanged external pre-push guard checks the full outgoing history.

No local Docker engine was available. The real pinned-container regression passed in deployment-contract CI; the native harness is additional evidence. Every Compose sign-in profile uses this shared gateway template. Proxy behavior for the other sign-in profiles and external deployment overlays are unchanged; no installed-node acceptance is claimed.

Privacy: synthetic data only. This PR changes the repository's gateway logging configuration, its documentation and tests. No live server, release, account, DNS, auth or host-security setting was changed.


Current head evidence: [Quality gates run 39883217768](https://example.com/synthetic/project/actions/runs/39883217768) succeeded on `922a8ed`: application, PostgreSQL, transcription, defense-eval, deployment contracts (including the real Docker gateway regression), publication and secret scans. Synthetic browser was skipped as out of scope, not an executed pass. Earlier evidence: run 39784257560 on `00c4628`. The earlier [hosted review](https://example.com/synthetic/project/pull/342#issuecomment-6270997206) was clean on `1f7e1ff`; it does not cover `00c4628`. The diff against main contains the seven files listed above.

- Merge prerequisite resolved: #341 is merged and this PR targets main directly. No merge or deployment is authorized.

### Gateway logging privacy follow-up
- Remove the stock default.conf in the gateway image; add real-entrypoint nginx -T inspection and raw/percent-encoded marked requests to every configured listener plus port 80, checking both log streams.
- Put the content-free allowlist in the unittest TestCase before unittest.main(), reject unlogged servers and all unexpected/request-derived formats, anchor status log lines, and cover unsupported includes with the required bounded-checker probe.
- Set NGINX_ENVSUBST_FILTER in the image; add entrypoint checks with colliding nginx-variable environment names, both with and without Compose's filter setting.

Refs #336. Regression baseline: 00c4628. Tests were added before the fixes, retaining the original allowlist and status regex behavior for the red runs; the Dockerfile was unchanged until those runs completed. The second red run includes column-zero leaking formats without a preceding blank line. The image safeguard assertions were also red before the Dockerfile changes.

Hosted review covers 1f7e1ff only.
